summary: Iteration 115 — RETEST of the four iteration-114 fixes. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter115_retest_fixes.py = 12/12 passing; iter114 regression suite = 19/19 passing. All three backend fixes verified: (1) manage-tranches now always overwrites total_amount (empty list → 0, percentage-only → 0, 150000 → 1000 downgrade works), (2) _resync_school_share_from_expenses overwrites a stale share_value with the new aggregate, resets amount→0 + value→'' on delete-all while keeping type='amount', and leaves a manually set type='percentage' value untouched, (3) GET /api/orders/school-payments now returns tranches for a renewal_meeting school (verified with a temp TEST_ school, since no renewal_meeting school exists in the DB). Frontend: Extra Students block IS now present in the 'Edit School: X' (editOnboardData) modal for an active school — full flow verified end-to-end: Add Batch → Grade 3 / 5 / 1000 → Save Extra Students → toast 'Added 1 extra-student tranche(s)' → POST 200 → modal auto-refetched (Grand Total 5,000 → 10,000, new '(Extra)' grade row) → GET /api/schools/inquiry/{id} shows the new 'Extra Students · Grade 3 · 5 × ₹1,000' tranche. AdminOrders Manage Tranches modal: all requested data-testids (tranche-0-percentage/status/notes plus amount/date/gst/up/delete) exist; deleting all rows and saving from the UI drove total_amount to 0 and rendered the 'No tranches yet — click Manage Tranches' empty state with the button still visible. Regression: /api/school-expenses/pnl-summary still returns rows and includes a zero-revenue meeting_done school with an expense.

minor.issue: Adding the same grade twice with increment_existing=false appends a second identically-named grade_pricing row ('Grade 3 (Extra)' twice). Consider merging into the existing '(Extra)' row or suffixing/counting so the school modal doesn't show duplicate rows.

Still replaces payment_tranches wholesale and re-links payments[] purely by index (tranche_index < len(new)); reordering rows silently re-links a paid payment to a different tranche. Unchanged from iter114 — needs a stable tranche id.
~68 legacy 'TEST_*' school inquiries from older test iterations are still in school_inquiries (TEST_Pipeline_School_*, TEST_Active_School, …). Not created by this run; consider a cleanup script.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Manage Tranches' button now always renders inside the details panel (verified with 0 tranches), but the Orders list itself is built from tranche rows, so a school with zero tranches disappears from the list entirely (view-details-{id} count = 0 after deleting all tranches). Net effect is unchanged from iter114: a converted/active school with no tranches still cannot get its first tranche added from Orders.

Row delete uses native window.confirm() and the modal uses raw <select> + native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Select/Calendar used elsewhere — visual inconsistency (carried over from iter114).

issues: DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby (console warning) — accessibility only
Duplicate identical 'Grade 3 (Extra)' rows displayed after two extra-student saves (backend data issue surfaced in UI)

action_items: Optional: make schools with zero tranches reachable on the Orders page (e.g. include converted/active schools with no tranches as a row, or add a school picker) so the always-visible Manage Tranches button is actually reachable for first-tranche entry.
Optional: merge repeat extra-student batches for the same grade instead of appending duplicate '(Extra)' grade rows.
Optional: replace index-based payment↔tranche linking with a stable tranche id; replace window.confirm and native select/date inputs in the Manage Tranches modal with shadcn components.
critical_code_review_comments: The Extra Students block now exists in three near-identical copies in AdminSchoolCRM.jsx (~L7308 renewal, ~L9601 onboard, ~L10890 edit) with duplicated data-testid values ('extra-students-section', 'save-extra-students-btn'). Extract a shared <ExtraStudentsBlock/> — the duplication is what caused the iter114 gate mismatch and now makes strict-mode selectors ambiguous if two modals ever mount together.
AdminSchoolCRM.jsx is ~13.8k lines and AdminOrders.jsx ~3.8k — far beyond the 700-line guideline.
manage_school_tranches and extra_students still take untyped `dict` payloads; no Pydantic validation of amount/date/status enums.

rca_of_the_issue: All four iter114 defects confirmed fixed in code and behaviour: schools.py manage_school_tranches now assigns onboarding['total_amount'] = round(explicit_total,2) unconditionally; expenses.py _resync_school_share_from_expenses parenthesises the type backfill and writes/clears value_field whenever type=='amount'; orders.py get_school_payments includes 'renewal_meeting' in the status $in; AdminSchoolCRM.jsx renders the Extra Students block in the editOnboardData modal (L10889 gate on showEditOnboardingModal.status ∈ converted/active/renewed/renewal_meeting) and refetches the school into editOnboardData after a successful POST, eliminating the stale-state overwrite reported in iter114.
